description: Your observatory is expanding its monitoring capability by incorporating stations from the IU (Global Seismograph Network) to improve global earthquake detection coverage. A FDSN StationXML inventory file for three IU stations has been placed at /home/ga/Desktop/iu_stations.xml containing stations ANMO (Albuquerque, New Mexico), HRV (Adam Dziewonski Observatory, Massachusetts), and KONO (Kongsberg, Norway). Import these stations into the SeisComP system so they are fully operational: the stations must appear in the database, their inventory must be available to scconfig, and scautopick and scamp module bindings must be configured for all three new stations. Save a listing of the complete network inventory (both existing GE and new IU stations) to /home/ga/Desktop/network_inventory.txt.
